reason: Both conversations correctly identified restricted airflow from the clogged door filter and never-cleaned condenser and guided the homeowner to a successful clean-and-retest with no unjustified parts or engineer call. Conversation 2 handled safety properly by telling the customer to switch off and unplug before removing the condenser, correctly described the machine as a condenser dryer, and efficiently bundled the filter, condenser and heat check into one step. Conversation 1 mislabelled the WTN85201GB as a 'heat-pump' dryer, sent the customer to pull the condenser without any unplug instruction, and then pasted 'switch it off and unplug it' boilerplate at odd moments, including after the fault was already fixed, which reads as careless. Conversation 1's proactive fabric-softener explanation and sensor-bar wipe were useful extras but do not outweigh the safety sequencing and accuracy issues.
